Mid and Small-Cap Stocks Rally on Strong Earnings and AI Speculation

Indian mid and small-cap stocks have experienced a rally, driven by strong corporate earnings and speculation surrounding Artificial Intelligence (AI). Analysts suggest that robust earnings could sustain this upward trend into 2026. The rally is partly fueled by investor interest in AI technologies, which is influencing market sentiment and investment decisions in these segments.
